facts.business: Travel Food Services Limited operates travel quick service restaurants (QSR), lounges, and technology-enabled services for travellers across airports in India and Malaysia, and select highway locations in India.
key_risks: Water scarcity or inefficient water use may affect operational continuity and increase operating costs
Workplace safety incidents may adversely affect employee well-being, operational continuity, and organizational reputation
Supply disruptions, supplier non-compliance, and reputational impacts
Potential regulatory, legal, and reputational implications from data privacy and cyber security risks
facts.related_party_note: Loans to related parties include INR 927.39 million to SSP Malaysia Sdn Bhd, INR 84.40 million to Semolina Kitchens Limited, INR 153.70 million to QMT Lifestyle and Technology Services Private Limited, INR 40.24 million to Eliteassist Technology and Services Private Limited, and INR 60.00 million impaired loan to Meghalaya Hotels Private Limited. Pledged 29,48,400 equity shares of GMR Hospitality Limited (8.40% of GMR's equity) as collateral for GMR's term loan of INR 640 million and overdraft of INR 30 million. Subscribed to 18,15,000 equity shares of GMR at INR 10 per share (INR 18.15 million). Sold 75.01% stake in Semolina Kitchens Limited on 14 October 2024. Tendered 16,01,851 equity shares of subsidiary Travel Food Services (Delhi Terminal 3) Private Limited under buyback scheme.
